meta.title: mvnex - Modern Maven developer experience
meta.description: mvnex is a native CLI that makes Maven workflows simpler without replacing Maven.
meta.ogDescription: A modern developer-experience layer for Maven projects.

hero.title: Maven stays Maven. The experience gets faster.
hero.description: mvnex is a native CLI for creating and evolving standard Maven projects with a simpler, more interactive workflow.

intro.title: A developer-experience layer for Maven.
intro.description: mvnex is not a new build system. It is a focused CLI that keeps Maven's project model intact while making common workflows feel more direct, discoverable, and pleasant.

problem.title: Maven is powerful. The everyday workflow can feel heavier than it needs to.
problem.description: Java developers often know exactly what they want to do, but still bounce between terminal commands, Maven coordinates, XML editing, wrapper setup, and project conventions. mvnex is about smoothing those moments without taking ownership away from Maven.
points: Project setup should feel guided, not repetitive.
Common dependency work should not require memorizing coordinates.
Generated projects should remain ordinary Maven projects.

highlights.title: Built around Maven
highlights.description: The goal is to enhance Maven workflows, not hide or replace the Maven ecosystem.

highlights.title: Native and focused
highlights.description: mvnex is a native CLI designed for fast project workflows and clear terminal interaction.

highlights.title: Low-risk adoption
highlights.description: Projects should remain standard Maven projects that teams can continue using without mvnex.

promise.title: Small commands, standard projects.
promise.description: mvnex should feel like a modern CLI in your terminal and disappear into standard Maven output in your repository.

items.title: Ergonomic defaults
items.description: Prompt when it helps, accept flags when automation matters, and keep decisions visible.

items.title: Maven-compatible results
items.description: The output should work with IDEs, CI, plugins, repositories, and normal mvn commands.

items.title: Room to grow
items.description: The same philosophy can extend from project creation into dependencies, updates, and repeated project tasks.

roadmap.title: Bring modern CLI ergonomics to Java projects without inventing a new ecosystem.

audience.title: Developers who like Maven's foundation, but want a calmer interface.
audience.description: mvnex is for Java developers, students, backend teams, and tool builders who want modern terminal ergonomics while staying inside the Maven ecosystem.

footer.tagline: Built as separate Astro documentation with the same visual identity as the portfolio.
